title: Case 002: Apartment number missing from the delivery address

details.data: Entirely synthetic; English; fictional geography; all times UTC

context: The authenticated order thread identifies the recipient, but the address is incomplete. Dispatch has paused the route label before loading.
initial_request: The tracking page says address clarification required. The building is correct; what do you need from me?
overview: The escalation snapshot comprises history events 001–002. Event 003 records the next agent action; the subsequent events provide the disclosed calibration follow-through. Facts learned later must not be used as if already known at escalation.

next_action.summary: Ask the authenticated recipient for the missing apartment number through the approved channel.

outcome: Dispatch confirms the corrected address on the shipment.
boundaries: Authentication was independently recorded; do not infer it just from the customer’s assertion. No delivery claim.

events.body: DL-002: 18 Copperfin Court, Merrow Quay. The building has multiple apartments; the order has no apartment number. Hold reason: incomplete address. The recipient’s order-linked portal session was verified by our account team.
The tracking page says address clarification required. The building is correct; what do you need from me?
Please confirm the apartment number at 18 Copperfin Court. We do not need entry codes or any other household details.
Apartment 4B. Please add that to DL-002; the street and building remain unchanged.
Your correction request was applied: DL-002 now reads Apartment 4B, 18 Copperfin Court, Merrow Quay. The address hold is cleared; it has not yet left the depot.
